🎥🎬: Twisted Metal (2023)
The world has become a wasteland where survival means staying alert, driving fast, and never trusting the wrong person. John Doe, a delivery driver with a sharp tongue, accepts a dangerous mission that could finally give him the fresh start he’s been looking for.
But the roads are filled with ruthless gangs, deadly drivers, and bizarre threats, including Sweet Tooth, a terrifying masked killer cruising around in a heavily armed ice cream truck. As John fights to complete his mission, every encounter brings new dangers and unexpected twists.
Combining wild car chases, brutal combat, and dark comedy, Twisted Metal transforms an ordinary delivery into a chaotic battle for survival.
Twisted Metal is now streaming on Peacock. #SonyPicsPartner
